title: Section close — Classical-limit implications
html: Together, the graded Baer-* structure on \mathcal{H}_q, the two-filtration bridge to Goncharov's period filtration, the classical Riemann zeta limit at q \to 1, and the adelic Tate squeeze fix the arithmetic consequences of the classical-limit functor. The final section of this chapter pairs that q \to 1 degeneration with the Lusztig canonical basis, the \Phi_q / A_J identification, and the dual reverse limit q \to \infty.
